name: Spook (fear)
body:
School necromancy [fear, mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

EFFECT

Duration 1d4 rounds
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes
Target Restrictions selected

DESCRIPTION

This effect word causes the target to become frightened for the duration. This word has no effect on targets with 5 or more Hit Dice.
